programme.title: Небо на Земле. Жертва всесожжения
programme.desc: В Ветхом Завете люди приходили к священнику и он совершал обряд, который очищал человека от греха. Бог дал пророку Моисею подробные указания – что, как и когда нужно приносить в жертву. Одна из жертв называлась жертвой всесожжения. Что это такое? Чем она отличалась от других жертв? Как она указывала на Иисуса Христа? Ведущий: Алексей Бритов, Гость: Виталий Олийник, руководитель Центра духовного просвещения

programme.title: Контрасты души. Правда или ложь: что выбрать?
programme.desc: Сказать правду или солгать – эта проблема встает часто. Ложь по мелочам и ложь в серьезной ситуации, когда кажется, что она спасет человека. Можно ли лгать во благо? Непростой вопрос еще более осложняется тем, что ни один современный человек практически никогда не говорит одну только правду. Когда и как следует выбирать правду и когда ложь? В этой практической проблеме помогает разобраться психолог-консультант Василий Половинко. Ведущий: Игорь Кириченко, Гость: Василий Половинко, психолог-консультант, священнослужитель

programme.title: Возрождая Россию. Служение семьям
programme.desc: В современном мире постоянно происходит множество изменений: в технологическом укладе, в отношениях в семье, в организации труда и отдыха. Нужно ли противиться или поддерживать эти изменения? Гости программы семейные консультанты Мария и Владимир Вачевы рассказывают о своем служении семьям, о проблемах современных семей, делятся своим мнением о будущем института семьи. Ведущий: Валерий Малышев, Гость: Мария Вачева, психолог, семейный консультант и Владимир Вачев, священнослужитель, семейный консультант

programme.title: Тайна жизни. Колибри
programme.desc: Самая маленькая птица на земном шаре – колибри. Это одно из самых красивых Божьих творений. Колибри живут там, где есть цветы, но особенно много их в тропиках. Большинство людей знает, что колибри является самой маленькой птичкой на земле и, пожалуй, на этом у многих познания об этом изумительном творении заканчиваются. В нашей программе вы узнаете не только об маневренности этой птицы и особенностях её строения, но и поразмышляете вместе с нами об возможностях синхронной эволюции колибри и цветка, которым она питается. Ведущий: Ольга Феофанова, Гость: Дарья Хасанова, магистр биологии

programme.title: Чашка семейного счастья. Как деньги могут разрушить или укрепить брак?
programme.desc: Долги, скрытые траты и разные подходы к бюджету – главные враги молодой семьи. Как вести честные финансовые переговоры и распределять роли? Почему верность в малом определяет ваше будущее благополучие? Как щедрость становится духовной практикой? Ведущий: Ирина Флорьянович, психолог, Гость: Сергей Парфенов, священнослужитель

programme.title: Принято считать. Третий лишний в отношениях
programme.desc: Треугольники в отношениях разрушают прямой диалог, отнимают силы и наполняют союзы ревностью, обидами и скрытой конкуренцией. «Третьим» может оказаться не только роман на стороне, но и мама, ребёнок, работа, зависимость или даже благочестивое служение. Классический треугольник спаситель–жертва–преследователь позволяет избегать изменений, но при этом медленно разрушает всех участников. Как понять, что вы уже живёте в треугольнике, а не в союзе «я–ты»? Какие шаги помогут вернуться к честной, прямой встрече друг с другом? Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Ирина Полищук, психолог, телесно-ориентированный терапевт

programme.title: Библия. Библия в СССР
programme.desc: Многосерийный фильм «Библия». История Библии была непростой в любой стране. Не стал исключением и СССР. В этой серии фильма эксперты в области истории Священного Писания рассказывают о пути Библии в нашей стране, начиная с дореволюционной России и заканчивая послеперестроечным периодом. programme.title: Целое во фрагменте. Сергей Довлатов. Тоска по норме

programme.title: Прикосновение. Удивительная точность
programme.desc: Есть ли конкретные доказательства того, что Библия исторически достоверна? Содержится ли в Священном Писании заслуживающая доверия информация относительно имен, мест и географических названий? Открытия, сделанные за последние 200 лет, свидетельствуют о достоверности Слова Божьего. Археология, демонстрируя точность деталей отраженных в библейской летописи, поддерживает нашу веру. Моавитский камень, найденный в 1868 году в Иордании, подтверждает атаки моавитян на Израиль, описанные в 4-й Книге Царств, 1-й и 3-й главе. Моавитский камень в точности описывает поражение моавитян и их последующее отступление, как это и изложено в Библии. Были найдены Лахишские письма. Эти невероятные документы, найденные в 40 км к северу от Беер Шевы, описывают нападение Навуходоносора на Иерусалим в 586 году до н. э. В этих письмах содержится детальное описание падения Иерусалима с точки зрения вавилонян. Лахишские письма подтверждают историческую достоверность падения Иерусалима. Они также свидетельствуют об истинности боговдохновенных пророков, чьи предсказания о нападении вавилонян на Иерусалим записаны в книгах Паралипоменон, Исаии и Иеремии. Цилиндр Кира, сделанный из глины. Этот археологический памятник описывает Кира, персидского царя, и его победу над Вавилоном, а также освобождение из рабства иудеев в 539 году до н. э. Это археологическое открытие представляет собой особую важность, ведь Кир более чем за 150 лет до своего рождения был назван в Книге Исаии 44:27, 28 и 45:1 Божьим избранным «пастырем», который и освободит Израиль из плена. Эти открытия вместе с рядом других продолжают служить доказательством точности и достоверности Библии. Они красноречиво свидетельствуют о Боге, Который позаботился о том, чтобы оставить в нашем мире свидетельство о Себе. Они утверждают нашу веру в целостность Писания. Ведущий: Ирина Кириченко

programme.title: Здравствуйте. Правильный уход за зубами (первая часть)
programme.desc: Красивой сверкающей улыбкой хотят обладать все без исключения. Однако даже очень хороший стоматолог не сможет ничего сделать, если человек не уделяет внимания гигиене ротовой полости и уходу за зубами. Ведь на самом деле основную работу по сохранению своих зубов мы должны делать самостоятельно. Как ухаживать за зубами и какие правила нужно соблюдать при ежедневной гигиене? programme.title: Библия. Библия в СССР
programme.desc: Многосерийный фильм «Библия». История Библии была непростой в любой стране. Не стал исключением и СССР. В этой серии фильма эксперты в области истории Священного Писания рассказывают о пути Библии в нашей стране, начиная с дореволюционной России и заканчивая послеперестроечным периодом. Также вы узнаете о борьбе большевиков с Книгой Божьей и значении Синодального перевода для верующих того времени. Ведущий: Евгений Зайцев, доктор теологии, кандидат философских наук, Гость: А. Руденко, исполнительный директор РБО, С. Ряховский, Начальствующий Епископ Российского объединенного союза христиан веры евангельской, А. Десницкий, доктор филологических наук, профессор РАН, Н. programme.title: Целое во фрагменте. Сергей Довлатов. Тоска по норме
programme.desc: При жизни писателя Сергея Довлатова не признавали и не печатали, и настоящее признание, в особенности на Родине, пришло к нему, как это часто бывает с писателями, лишь после смерти. programme.desc: Быть довольным тем, что имеешь – важный и нужный навык. Умение радоваться простым вещам, мелочам, которые мы часто не замечаем, делает нас счастливыми и умиротворенными. programme.title: Chef De Serviço T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No capítulo de hoje Carlos Afonso traz 3 receitas que representam o tema da “Simplicidade”. Começa com um “Feijão Guisado com Ovo Escalfado”, uma receita simples, vegetariana e com matriz portuguesa, depois uma “Açorda de Ovas com Pescada Frita”, um prato com apenas 3 ingredientes principais e, por fim, uns “Papos de Anjo com Calda de Citrinos”, um doce conventual super simples de se fazer.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No capítulo de hoje, Carlos Afonso, para o tema “Digital”, traz 3 receitas que considera terem uma grande repercussão na internet: uma “Salada Caprese Alentejana”, uns “Canelones de Vaca e Queijo da Ilha” e, por fim, um “Bolo de Caneca com Morangos e Chantilly”.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T4 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No capítulo de hoje, Carlos Afonso traz 3 receitas rápidas para representar o tema do episódio: uma “Tiborna de Cogumelos de Coentrada”, fácil de se fazer em cerca de 10 minutos; uns “Ovos Mexidos com Espargos”, um prato básico mas que precisa de alguma técnica para atingir o ponto perfeito dos ovos, e por fim, uma “Salada de Penne com Pesto de Poejo”, uma receita do norte de Itália com um toque alentejano, super rápido de se fazer.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T4 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No capítulo de hoje Carlos Afonso traz 3 receitas que refletem sobre o tema “Conexão”: uns “Peixinhos da Horta”, uma receita que une Portugal e Japão através de um mito; uma “Açorda de Carabineiros”, uma herança Árabe que se manteve em Portugal até aos dias de hoje; e, por fim, uma “Sopa Dourada Rica”, uma receita que foi introduzida na cultura nacional fazendo parte dos doces conventuais portugueses.

programme.title: Cozinhar À Italiana T2 - Ep. 10

programme.title: Cozinhas Com Nova Vida T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Lisa adora cozinhar, mas a cozinha dela é um desastre. Ellen vai transformar esta cozinha no coração da casa.

programme.title: Cozinhas Com Nova Vida T1 - Ep. 2

programme.title: Doces Do Ofício T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Por doença celíaca ou intolerância, há quem procure evitar o glúten. O Francisco sugere três boas opções sem glúten, mas com todo o sabor: Com arroz, millet e milho tufados, fará a base de minitartes crocantes, recheadas com um cremoso de mascarpone.Com farinha de amêndoa e cacau em pó, há bolo de chocolate aromatizado por especiarias e peras. Para o fim, o chef propõe um original creme brullé de baunilha com a textura de chantilly.

programme.title: As Doces Iguarias De Rudolph T1 - Ep. 158
programme.desc: Mestre Rudolph van Veen mostra-nos o seu conhecimento e paixão para a cozinha. Ele cria os mais deliciosos pratos doces e salgados, deixando-nos ficar com água na boca. Rudolph sabe como criar as receitas mais encantadoras, e com a sua ajuda todos podem fazer bolos e os mais deliciosos pastéis e tortas.

programme.title: As Doces Iguarias De Rudolph T1 - Ep. 159
programme.desc: Mestre Rudolph van Veen mostra-nos o seu conhecimento e paixão para a cozinha. Ele cria os mais deliciosos pratos doces e salgados, deixando-nos ficar com água na boca. programme.title: À Mesa De Nisha Katona T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Nisha Katona cozinha um caril de rabo de boi e perna de vaca, além de camarões grelhados no churrasco com especiarias.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Como comer bem, de forma saudável, sem comprometer o paladar? Saberá responder a esta questão no final do programa que a Tia Cátia preparou para si.. a pensar na sua saúde! Courgette recheada com ratatouille é uma excelente opção para entrada, acompanhamento ou até mesmo como prato principal. Esta verdadeira bomba de nutrientes será a primeira receita! Vai ainda ser servido um cremoso Bacalhau sem natas.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T4 - Ep. 32
programme.desc: A Tia Cátia tem a sorte de ter amigos que, como ela, se divertem a cozinhar. Hoje vai ter a companhia da Sílvia Brandi, uma grande amiga italiana que vai preparar três receitas rápidas, de la mama: Alcachofras à Judaica, fritas em azeite por duas vezes! Esparguete com queijo pecorino e uma boa mistura de pimentas. E ainda um tiramissù com tudo a que tem direito. Prontos para cozinhar à italiana?.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T4 - Ep. 31
programme.desc: Quando os filhos da Tia Cátia eram pequenos, costumavam passar horas a apanhar conchinhas, à beira-mar… Hoje teremos três receitas saídas da concha! Como entrada, mexilhões gratinados com um toque de malagueta… O prato principal será uma massada de amêijoas suadas na cataplana. Como sobremesa, há madalenas com a forma original, em concha, e com gosto português! Venha daí abrir estas conchas com a Tia Cátia!.

programme.title: Naturalmente T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Este Naturalmente está cheio de frescura e vitaminas. A nutricionista Iara Rodrigues escolheu para este programa três receitas com fruta a que ninguém vai resistir: gelado cremoso de fruta; bolo de maçã e salada de rúcula e morangos. São receitas gulosas, mas saudáveis, para comer sem remorsos.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Neste capítulo Miguel Mesquita escolhe as 3 receitas que definem a sua personalidade: Em primeiro lugar, uma Tiborna de Sardinha e Escabeche, uma das receitas que mais gosta de apresentar às visitas que recebe em sua casa. Em segundo lugar, Bochechas de Porco com Puré de Aipo e Maçã, uma receita que representa aquilo que mais aprecia num prato.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Neste capítulo Miguel Mesquita escolhe as 3 receitas que foram criação sua: Em primeiro lugar, um Cevadoto de Gambão, uma novidade no que diz respeito às receitas que apresenta nas suas redes sociais. Em segundo lugar, uma Barriga de Porco, Maçãs e Laranja, uma receita onde combinou diferentes sabores enquanto preparava o episódio. E, por fim, um Cheesecake de Café, criado a partir de uma bebida que experimentou.

programme.title: Renovações Em Família T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Jéssica e Lizzy vão em auxílio de uma família cuja casa se encheu, ao longo da pandemia, com a chegada de dois filhos e de inúmeras compras feitas online. Agora, é altura de devolver a organização ao lar.

programme.title: Cadernos Da Filipa T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Neste episódio vamos elevar o arroz em três receitas deliciosas! A Filipa mostra os seus Pastelinhos de camarão e arroz, um Risotto de ervilhas e limão e termina com o Arroz doce da sua mãe.

programme.title: Filipa Gomes Cozinha Com Twist T2 - Ep. 44
programme.desc: Se no outro episódio foi ensinado a cozinhar alguns básicos como massa folhada, requeijão e fruta em calda, agora chegou o momento de preparar receitas com essas coisas boas! Primeiro vamos fazer umas tartes caprese, a seguir uns canelones de abobora, requeijão e noz, e por ultimo um bolo de canela, erva doce e pêra. Tudo delicioso e feito de raiz!.

programme.title: Prato Do Dia T2 - Ep. 55
programme.desc: Cozinhar com álcool pode tornar bons pratos em autênticas iguarias. É o caso de um queijo Brie no forno com frutos secos e Vinho do Porto, uma costeleta de porco com cerveja e puré de batata-doce, e uma tarte de chocorum.

programme.title: Prato Do Dia T2 - Ep. 54
programme.desc: Preconceitos à parte, as conservas e os enlatados podem ser a chave para refeições verdadeiramente deliciosas. Para quem não acredita, o melhor é mesmo experimentar pratos como uma salada de muxama de atum, umas conchas de atum, couves-de-Bruxelas e anchovas, e um simples mas saboroso bolo de milho.

programme.title: Comtradição Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Para começar mais uma visita aos Estados Unidos o Henrique irá cozinhar uma Sopa de Amêijoas, de seguida, um típico Bacon Cheese Burger e, por fim, uma saborosa Pecan Pie, uma das sobremesas dele.

programme.title: Comtradição Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Voltamos, mais uma vez no Comtradição, ao Brasil e agora para o Henrique cozinhar uma Moqueca de Peixe, o tão conhecido Cuscuz-Paulista e o doce Quindim, mas desta vez no copo.

programme.title: Sabores de Itália com Silvia Colloca T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Silvia viaja até Ascoli Piceno e envolve-se na cultura do café italiano. Inspirada pela experiência, ela regressa a casa em Torricella para fazer a bolacha perfeita para molhar no café... tozzetti (biscoitos de amêndoa e limão). De volta à estrada e viajando pela costa do Adriático, Silvia visita a atarefada vila costeira de San Benedetto del Tronto e transforma algum do marisco mais fino de Itália em acepipes.

programme.title: Sabores de Itália com Silvia Colloca T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Silvia vai até à vila costeira de Vasto onde luta contra um polvo em troca da receita de uma salada de marisco chamada pólipo con patate (polvo com salada de batata). Após isso, vai aos mercados Sulmona, em Abruzzo, para comprar pêssegos frescos para a sobremesa espetacular de verão pesche al vino con mascarpone (pêssegos ensopados em vinho com creme mascarpone).

programme.title: À La Barrios T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: O episódio de hoje é inteiramente dedicado a homenagear clássicos da gastronomia nacional. Mas como isto é o À la Barrios a primeiro receita também tinha de o ser. Portanto, a um Rancho adicionamos massa, ao que lhe chamamos de Massa Rancho. E digo-vos, lembro-me da primeira vez que dei uma garfada numa tigela com rancho, mas sem a massa.

programme.title: Joana Express T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Neste episódio de Joana Express a cozinha transforma-se num verdadeiro festival de sabores. Começamos com uma Salada de Abóbora, rápida e cheia de personalidade. Seguimos para um reconfortante arroz caldoso servido com peixe à escolha, hoje sendo raia. E terminamos em grande com uma irresistível Tarte Tatin de Pêra, perfeita para adaptar à sua fruta favorita e surpreender à mesa com um toque doce e criativo.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T15 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Quando a Tia Cátia faz viagens grandes em família, prepara sempre alguns snacks para os seus rapazes, que são de muito alimento! Aqui ficam três propostas: Wraps de frango, com um leve aroma a cominhos, e um cremoso molho césar. Sanduíche com carne do cachaço assada no forno, a baixa temperatura. Entra desfiada no pão, e acompanha com rúcula. E quadrados de tataki de atum, com o atum cozinhado no ponto.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T20 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: A Tia Cátia inspirou-se na estrutura do clássico mil-folhas francês para preparar um menu em camadas... mas não de massa folhada! Temos: Curgete laminada e creme de quatro queijos, numa sobreposição original e com um sabor muito guloso. Seguem-se peitos de galinhas, cortados a preceito, com recheio de presunto e mozarela. E ainda finas fatias de maçã, intercaladas com açúcar e canela. São o quanto baste para uma sobremesa divinal!

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T11 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Conhecem algum miúdo que não goste de uma boa sanduíche? Ora, com o filho mais novo, a Tia Cátia vai preparar três versões... que são verdadeiras refeições! Começam com uma sanduíche de ovo, com maionese de manjericão e pão de cereais caseiro. Segue-se a clássica sanduíche de panado. Mas esta é de peru, cozinhado no forno, e servido com um molho de mostarda. Para acompanhar: sumo de beterraba.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T18 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A Tia Cátia gosta de testar tendências, e de conhecer formas diferentes de estar na vida e na cozinha. Com a Ana Galvão, hoje teremos um menu de inspiração macrobiótica: Sopa de miso com gengibre, cebola, abóbora e coentros. Quentinha e super reconfortante. Falafel de lentilhas, que leva também uma porção de millet e acompanha com um delicioso molho agridoce.

programme.title: Tragam Pão! T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje de Tragam Pão!, viajamos até ao Barrocal, o lado mais serrano do Algarve, onde a tradição e a memória ganham lugar à mesa. Para dar início a esta homenagem, a Noélia prepara uma Empada de Perdiz. De seguida, chega um reconfortante Cozido Algarvio, feito com os produtos da serra, ao qual a chef Noélia dá um toque muito pessoal ao juntar atum. Para terminar, um Bolo de Figo regado com mel.

programme.title: Tragam Pão! T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje de Tragam Pão!, a Noélia dedica-se à cozinha vegetariana, numa homenagem à sua filha, Vânia. Começamos com uma deliciosa Tarte de Legumes. De seguida, chega um irresistível Arroz de Cenoura, uma receita cheia de sabor que prova que não é preciso carne nem peixe para criar um prato memorável.

programme.title: Renovações Em Família T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Conheça a família Looper, composta por oito elementos, incluindo dois pares de gémeos nascidos com apenas dezassete meses de diferença. A equipa da Renovações em Família renova a casa para destacar a individualidade de cada adolescente e prepara ainda uma surpresa para os pais.

programme.title: Filipa Gomes Cozinha Com Twist T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Hoje apresentamos um menu do dia, daqueles que se encontram em qualquer restaurante à hora de almoço. Para entrada um picadinho de febras de porco preto, depois as velhas e boas pataniscas com um arroz de coentros malandrinho e por fim o clássico pudim molotof mas em versão mini! Tudo por 6,99€ por pessoa com bebida e café incluído.

programme.title: Filipa Gomes Cozinha Com Twist T2 - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Hoje, no Cozinha com Twist, pensámos naqueles dias em que faz mais sentido simplificar! Cozinhar é sempre bom, quer seja um prato muito elaborado, ou receitas mais simples mas que nos enchem as medidas na perfeição. Apresentamos três receitas que levam poucos ingredientes, mas com muito sabor: umas bruschetas de chevre, diospiro e presunto, um rago de ossobuco e polenta, e um bolo mágico de gelado e farinha.

programme.title: Cadernos Da Filipa T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Hoje a Filipa vai cozinhar receitas saborosas com ingredientes saudáveis e nutritivos! Começamos por uma Curgetti com camarão salteado, depois um Wrap de ovo, abacate e atum e, finalmente, uns Queques de aveia, banana, arandos e mel. Quem disse que não é possível comer sem culpa?.

programme.title: Comtradição T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Hoje vamos explorar a gastronomia do Distrito de Beja. Vamos ter uma Carne com Amêijoas, uma Açorda Alentejana e, para terminar, um clássico: um Toucinho do Céu.

programme.title: Comtradição Pelo Mundo T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: O Henrique acaba de aterrar no Japão, para nos apresentar três receitas típicas da região. Começa com uma Sopa Miso, seguida de uma tão conhecida Shushi Bowl e de umas Panquecas Souflé Japonesas super fofas.

programme.title: O Da Joana T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Neste episódio de estreia de O DA JOANA, propomos uma refeição planeada em função da sobremesa. Vamos fazer o Pastelão de ovo da avó Maria Joana, depois um frango assado, tudo isto para nos permitir guardar espaço para uma gloriosa Tarte aberta de frutas como desfecho.

programme.title: O Da Joana T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio a Joana faz um menu completo de bistrô! Começamos com uma Tosta de salmão, depois um Risoto de camarão e lima, para encher o olho, mais uns Arrancini, porque tudo se aproveita no bistre da Joana, e terminamos com um Baked cheesecake de morangos, para o “UAU factor”.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T10 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O universo das saladas é bem mais do que umas folhinhas de alface com umas rodelas de tomate. A Tia Cátia fará três saladas que são uma refeição completa e nutritiva! Com frango, maçã, couve-de-bruxelas e uns quantos vegetais crus, vai preparar uma salada fresca, a regar com molho à base de mostarda e maionese. Com feijão, batata-doce assada e abacate fará uma salada consistente, para quem procura uma alternativa vegetariana.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T12 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Para hoje, a Tia Cátia tem um menu especialmente desenhado para o Pedro Granger, que não é um ás na cozinha, mas que aprecia um bom jantar. Temos tártaro de peixe, fresco e aromatizado com lima e cebolinho. Acompanha com tortilhas de trigo. Mini-hambúrgueres de peru, muito bem temperados. São servidos com batata-doce frita e ainda molho de maionese e mostarda. Para o fim, há panacota de chocolate, com uma ganache super cremosa!

programme.title: #Superfácil T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Neste episódio de #Superfácil, Miguel Mesquita leva-nos numa viagem muito apetecível aos sabores coloridos e vibrantes do México. Começamos com uma crocante e fresca Salada de Tortilhas com Abacate e Pico de Gallo. Seguimos para uns intensos Tacos de Peixe com Creme de Chipotle, perfeitos para uma refeição descontraída com um toque fumado e picante. E terminamos em grande com um icónico Bolo Tres Leches mas desta feita com aroma a café.

programme.title: Tragam Pão! T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje de Tragam Pão!, o protagonismo vai para o peixe e o marisco, dois ingredientes incontornáveis na cozinha da Noélia. Começamos com uma fresca Salada de Camarão e seguimos para um irresistível Socarrat: um arroz bem crocante, cheio de sabor, acompanhado por peixe e camarão.

programme.title: Tragam Pão! T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje de Tragam Pão!, são as memórias da chef Noélia que dão o mote a cada receita. Começamos com uma Cavala Braseada, uma homenagem ao seu irmão, pescador de profissão. De seguida, Noélia prepara uma Sopa de Amêndoas com Camarão, um prato que a transporta para o dia do seu casamento, celebrado na época em que as amendoeiras estão em flor.

programme.title: Comtradição T10 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Neste episódio o Henrique apresenta para entrada Trufas de Alheira, um prato simples, mas que fará um brilharete. Para prato principal um Arroz de Berbigão, inspirado numa mistura de arroz de marisco e feijoada. E para terminar, uma versão asiática de um Cheesecake Tropical para sobremesa.

programme.title: Comtradição T2 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Hoje viajamos até ao Algarve, não para ir á praia mas para nos deliciarmos com algumas receitas inspiradas na sua gastronomia. É a pensar no distrito de Faro que o Henrique nos prepara hoje uma Canja de Conquilhas, depois umas Lulas á Algarvia e termina com uma também veraneante Febra com salada montanheira.

programme.title: Renovações Em Família T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Jéssica e Lizzy lembram Koey, uma mãe solteira, da importância de cuidar de si própria enquanto transformam a sua casa num verdadeiro reino à sua medida.

programme.title: Cozinhas Com Nova Vida T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Andrew e Leah são o casal mais descontraído e excêntrico de Eagle Rock. Embora adorem a sua casa de estilo espanhol, a cozinha está completamente desenquadrada. Com um orçamento pequeno e grandes sonhos, Ellen vai ter de ser realmente criativa para agradar a este casal.

programme.title: Cozinhas Com Nova Vida T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Laura e James têm quatro filhos e mais um a caminho! Têm, também, uma cozinha minúscula com o volume de culinária de um restaurante movimentado! Ellen adora esta família e está determinada a dar-lhes mais do que eles alguma vez poderiam ter esperado.

programme.title: À La Barrios T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Este episódio é o sonho de quem trabalha aqui no estúdio de À La Barrios, pois cada prato é escolhido por três membros da nossa equipa.

programme.title: À La Barrios T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Para este programa pensei em partilhar as dicas-base para uma marmita de sucesso com um fim muito específico e útil: a praia, uma circunstância em que uma marmita dá muito muito muito jeito. Para já, porque na praia a única coisa que se compra para comer é uma bola de Berlim com creme. Depois tudo o resto que se compra na praia já ascende a uns montantes que vai lá vai.

programme.title: Gone In 60 Seconds
programme.desc: Buckle-up as Eleanor, the fast and furious Ford Fastback Mustang, takes you on a full-throttle ride you'll never forget. The Assignment: To steal 48 muscle and exotic cars! The Challenge: Avoid getting caught!

programme.title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
programme.desc: As a small time hood Eddie is about to go back to jail. In order to escape this fate he deals information on stolen guns to the feds. Simultaneously he is supplying arms to his bank robbing/kidnapping hoodlum chums.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman (Rainman) plays the likable graduate student and marathon runner of the title, unwillingly trapped in a killing game of intrigue involving a Nazi fugitive, Christian Szell.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

programme.title: Serpico
programme.desc: A true-life drama of a cop whose revelations about the extent of bribery in the New York Police Department almost led to his death and resulted in the creation of the Knapp Commission.

programme.title: Who'll Stop The Rain?
programme.desc: In this gripping thriller, Vietnam vet Ray Hicks (Nick Nolte) smuggles heroin back to the States for his pal John, but when Ray and John’s wife (Tuesday Weld) deliver the drugs, they are ambushed. Now on the run, they must find a way to survive!

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: At Close Range
programme.desc: A son wants to be like his father and earn himself a place in the family crime syndicate. Together with his brother, he forms his own gang to gain his dad's respect. Efforts backfire as the father fears that he is losing control.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: The January Man
programme.desc: A killer comedy that has an ex-cop trailing a serial murderer... and the mayor's sexy daughter! Kevin Kline leads an all-star cast that includes Susan Sarandon, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Harvey Keitel and Rod Steiger.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Comedy sensation John Candy plays the stressed-out air traffic controller whose much-needed family holiday yields one hysterical misadventure after another.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii - The Island of Oahu
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won’t find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy’s Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord - From Sea to Sea
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife - The Queen of the Canaries
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Tha mòran ri dhèanamh – cluasagan rin crathadh is leabaidh ri càradh. Ge-tà, chan eil sin furasta le Fuigheag mun cuairt. There’s much to be done - pillows to shake and a bed to be made. But this is not easy with Fuigheag around.

programme.title: Dòtaman
programme.desc: Tha Dòtaman a' falbh air làithean saora anns a' phrògram spòrsail seo bho 1989. Thèid air turas cuide ri Donaidh agus Rhoda 's iad a' cluich, a' seinn agus ag innse storaidh mu chuspair làithean saora. Tha Cagnaidh is Crotal deiseal is deònach agus bidh Nelson is Napoleon gu dileas aig gleoca nam pioghaid - feuch gum bi sibh deiseal airson innse dè an uair a tha e? Dòtaman goes on holiday in this colourful classic from the archives. Join Donnie and Rhoda as they dress up, sing and share a story on the topic. Furry friends Cagnaidh and Crotal join in the fun, while Nelson and Napoleon keep time at the Dòtaman clock!

programme.title: Meaban and Moo
programme.desc: Bidh Linda a’ tadhal air a caraidean Meaban is Moo sa bhothan aca gus dùbhlain spòrsail a chur romhpa. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha i ag iarraidh orra rudan blàth a lorg. Tha cùisean air a dhèanamh nas duilghe ge-tà agus caora air splaoid sa bhothan! Linda visits her friends Meaban and Moo at their hut to set them fun challenges. In this programme, she tasks them with finding warm things. However, a sheep on the loose in the hut makes their task more challenging!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha a h-uile duine uabhasach trang air an eilean. Tha Àtaidh a’ sgeadachadh nan craobhan agus tha Tilidh air seann taidhear a lorg, leis an cluich iad. Tha an taidhear a’ steigeadh timcheall stamag Bhlòir agus feumaidh Tilidh, Àtaidh, Nìp agus na Boga-bogadaich smaoineachadh air plana airson a shaoradh. Everyone is very busy on the Island. Abney is decorating the trees and Teal has found an old tyre to do tricks with. The tyre gets stuck around Bop’s tummy and Teal, Abney, Neep and the Poc-Pocs must think what to do.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag Bhreac is Seillean tuathal leis na rinn iad de thoinneamh. Daolag Bhreac and Seillean are dizzy after the amount of spinning they’ve done.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan and Gran are enjoying a beach clean, but the rubbish seems to have a mind of its own! When a yogurt pot goes walkabout, Stan spies a mystery! Tha Dan is Gran nan glòraidh 's iad a' glanadh na tràghad, ach tha an sgudal gu math an-fhoiseil! Nuair a tha poit iogart a' gluasad, tha Dan a' faicinn rùn-dìomhair!

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Eoghan Dòmhnallach a’ leughadh Siorcaidh NicSiorc agus a’ Chrùbag Bheag Bhìodach. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Alison Murray. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. Eoghan MacDonald reads Siorcaidh NicSiorc agus a’ Chrùbag Bheag Bhìodach, written and illustrated by Alison Murray and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha a’ chàraid a’ faighinn gu lethbhreacadair na sgoile is a’ dèanamh tòrr lethbhreacan dhiubh fhèin. A-nis feumaidh Pòl is an teaghlach feuchainn ri na lethbhreacan air fad a chruinneachadh. Following an incident with the school photocopier, Dave must round up a horde of photocopied baby Spud twins.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl a’ cleachdadh magnait airson ionmhas a lorg, ach ’s ann a tha e a’ tarraing meatailt a’ bhaile air fad thuige, fiù ’s na rudan mòra! Dave uses a magnet to search for treasure, but ends up attracting all of the town’s metal - and not just the small stuff.

programme.title: Stri
programme.desc: Tha preasantairean CBBC ALBA uabhasach fhèin measail air dùbhlain ach saoil cò shoirbhicheas is Mhairi a’ tadhal orra? The CBBC ALBA presenters love a good challenge but who will emerge victorious as Mhairi joins them?

programme.title: Billy Burach
programme.desc: Young piper Billy is loud, chaotic, and totally out of sync with his family band. Kicked out just before the village show, Billy’s ready to give up...

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Sa phrògram seo bheir i sùil air an neach-ealain ainmeil Frida Kahlo, agus seallaidh i dhut mar a nì thu dealbh anns an stoidhle aice. Choirstaidh is back with another programme from her studio A’ Chùil. In this programme, she takes a look at the famous artist Frida Kahlo and shows you how to make your own picture in her style.

programme.title: Turas a Bhradain
programme.desc: Iasgach a' bhradain air cuid de na h-aibhnichean is àlluinne an Alba - cuide ri Neen NicAoidh. An odyssey through Scotland's fishing rivers with Neen MacKay.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Tha Maria Robasdan à Obar Dheathain a’ tadhal air Joy san stiùidio agus tha Calum MacIlleathain a’ cur air a bhrògan dannsaidh airson Bhangra fheuchainn le buidheann ann an Dùn Èideann. Joy Dunlop guides us through the next steps to speak Gaelic. Learner Maria Robertson from Aberdeen chats to Joy in the studio, and Calum Maclean dons his dancing shoes as he tries out Bhangra dancing in Edinburgh. Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara/Mermaid Tales
programme.desc: Kate Macleod, The Hebridean Mermaid, takes us on a journey to some of the hidden gems of the Hebrides.

programme.title: Duncan Mackenzie | Dìleab nam Beann
programme.desc: An dlùth dhàimh eadar stàcair & eòlaiche eachdraidh-ionadail agus tìr a shinnsearan. The story of Duncan Mackenzie's passion for the landscape of north west Scotland.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: How hundreds of people were affected by the North Talisker resettlement more than 100 years ago.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap set on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Chan urrain do Pheadar a bhi dìomhain agus tha Fraochy Bay làn de na h-annasan a tha e a cruthachadh. An turus-sa tha poit-tì agus Torcuil am bàrd ga chuir air ais agus air adhart. Peter the inventor can't be idle and the residents of Fraochy Bay are well acquainted with his creations. On this occasion a teapot and Torcuil the poet send him on a journey full of paradoxes!

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Iain MacKinnon reads excerpts from Gliocas bhon Bhioball by Donald Saunders, and Mairi MacInnes narrates from The Mother’s Catechism.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Joe Crowley, Datshiane Navanayagam and Adam Henson head to Westacre Estate in Norfolk to discover how a historic rural estate is adapting to survive in the modern world. At a financially critical time of year, Datshiane looks at one of the estate's most valuable yet vulnerable crops, blueberries, and meets the estate owner to find out how traditional estates are diversifying and evolving to secure their future. Joe joins the conservation team as they work to restore an important area of wet woodland, boosting biodiversity and creating habitats for wildlife. He also visits a tenant brewery and lends a hand to craft a local ale. Meanwhile, Adam meets the estate's farm manager, who is looking at ways to help run the land in a more cost-effective way through collaboration between livestock and arable farming.

programme.title: Emergency 24/7
programme.desc: A catastrophic dual carriageway collision brings two patients to Southmead Emergency Department: Tom, the driver who caused the crash, and Olli, the man whose van he hit. Meanwhile, a young girl is brought to Resus after falling from her horse, unable to move or feel her legs. With her parents watching anxiously, a CT scan and then an MRI reveal no obvious physical cause for her symptoms. As the uncertainty deepens, the clinical challenge must be balanced with the emotional weight of caring for a young patient and her frightened family.

programme.title: Colin from Accounts

programme.desc: Charming cottages and a lovely barn conversion are on the property shortlist in the Northamptonshire countryside as Denise Nurse helps Caroline from Kent return to what she calls her happy place. programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Buckle up with Roo Irvine and Danny Sebastian as they get a taste of Island life, crossing the Irish sea to the Isle of Man in their oh-so-charming Morris Traveller. It’s a whistlestop tour of Manx antiques emporia, where Roo takes a fancy to an entire school of glass fish and thumbs through a glossy style magazine from the 1930s. Danny tunes in to a very stylish small screen and chances his arm with a hefty item with leonine appeal. But it’s not all about the shopping. With the island’s TT racing spirit in the air, our duo detour to the Isle of Man Motor Museum, where things get just a little bit chaotic with some home-grown, pint-sized rides. Then it’s off to the very first showdown, under the watchful eye of road trip legend Anita Manning. But will it be fur or fins that wins the bidders over?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the grand finale, and the remaining candidates are ready to compete for the coveted title of Britain’s best amateur sewer. The judges, Patrick Grant and Esme Young, set three challenges inspired to test their skills for one final time. First up, the sewers get gala ready with a cummerbund and bow tie. Next, it’s time for the transformation challenge, where the sewers take gala tableware and turn it into an outfit for the perfect day-after hangout, the beach club. Finally, inspired by the Met Gala in New York, the sewers must create outfits on the theme of metamorphosis as if they had an invite to the Sewing Bee gala. Three finalists, three challenges, but only one contestant will be crowned the twelfth champion of The Great British Sewing Bee.

programme.title: The Wonder of Animals
programme.desc: Bats have colonised remote corners of the planet to become one of most widespread mammals on earth. Chris Packham explores their incredible anatomy, physiology and senses to understand what enables them to thrive in some surprising places. Tiny hairs on their wings give them a detailed airflow map during flight, heat sensors on the nose of vampire bats means they can sense the most blood-rich areas of a prey's body, and iron oxide particles in the bat brain may act as a compass allowing them to find the most direct route back to the roost.

programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: The South Pacific islands are the most remote in the world. Their extraordinary isolation has created some of the most curious, surprising and precarious examples of life found anywhere on earth; from giant crabs that tear open coconuts, to flesh-eating caterpillars that impale their prey on dagger-like claws. Human culture is different too. The men of Pentecost Island celebrate their annual harvest by leaping from 20-metre high scaffolds, with only forest vines to break their fall. And on the tiny island of Anuta, possibly the most remote community of people on the planet, the locals survive entirely on what they can grow and catch. The South Pacific's innumerable islands look like pieces of paradise, but the reality of life here is sometimes very different, with waves the size of buildings, brutal tropical storms, and, in the far south, even blizzards. This is the real South Pacific.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from the Grand Pier at Weston-super-Mare in Somerset, where experts Catherine Southon and Jonathan Pratt pick out some gems to value. Among them are rare medals that once belonged to an early aviator and puppets that look like the Swedish band Abba. Plus Paul delves into the history of seaside entertainment.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Jennie Bond, James Bye, Kadeena Cox and Aurie Styla take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. programme.title: Clive Myrie’s Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: For 11 months of the year, the city of La Vega is well off the tourist track. But each February, it bursts into life. Over the course of four weekends, it’s loud, hot and colourful as visitors from all over the world arrive to join in the famous street carnivals. Clive is in the party mood and throws himself into the fun. He stocks up on local sweet treats, meets talented mask makers and prepares outrageous costumes before joining the parade in full costume.

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Lochs
programme.desc: In the first programme of the series, Paul visits Wester Ross and discovers the heritage of Little Loch Broom. He then travels to the off-grid community of Scoraig where he learns about violin making and wind power, before taking the plunge to explore the hidden depths of the Corrieshalloch Gorge. In Ullapool, on the shores of Loch Broom, Paul learns the Russian word for parsley and how a huge fleet of Russian fish factory ships known as Klondykers used to visit the town. He then follows a red herring that connects the lochs of the west coast to the history of the slave trade. Journey’s end is on the rocky summit of Stac Pollaidh.

programme.title: Race Against the Tide
programme.desc: Join host Iain Stirling for the most nail-biting episode yet – a celebration of skill, teamwork and sheer determination. It all began with seven hopeful pairs of newbies, their pros and a beach full of promises. Now, only one team will triumph before Mother Nature wipes the slate clean. St Andrews’ stunning West Sands becomes the sandy beach battleground as three teams of sand-sculpting hopefuls face their toughest challenge yet. Our finalists – Athena and Rachel, Shane and Lisa, and Yusuf and Johannes – have just six hours to create the most ambitious sculptures of their lives before the North Sea sweeps in one last time to claim their masterpieces. Fittingly, the theme is Ultimate Sandcastles – a test of skill, creativity and resilience. Judges Sadie and Jamie are demanding height, arches, spiral staircases and that elusive wow factor. But will our sculptors play it safe or push boundaries to deliver something truly spectacular? Expect drama, collapses, creative differences and plenty of emotion.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: In Watergate Bay, one of Cornwall’s surfing hotspots, two teenage boys are caught in one of the beach’s notorious rip currents. When three distress signals are activated off the Pembrokeshire coast, the Fishguard crew race out to their location; en route, they discover there are seven kayakers in need of rescue, with winds gusting at 50 miles an hour. On one of the hottest days of the year, the Lyme Regis crew receive reports of a man suffering from heat stroke on a remote stretch of beach. And on the Isle of Wight, a fossil hunter is trapped waist deep in mud - with the tide steadily rising.

programme.title: Emergency 24/7
programme.desc: 26-year-old Kye is rushed into Resus suffering alcohol withdrawal seizures, but ED consultant Hazel is also concerned about an abscess on his arm that has failed to respond to treatment. Hazel questions Kye about his drug use and uncovers a possible cause for his resistance to antibiotics. She consults with the microbiology team, and in the meantime, begins a different treatment. After a motorbike crash, older couple Ken and Carol are brought into the emergency department, with Ken in extreme pain. Scans reveal six fractured ribs, putting 82-year-old Ken at high risk of serious complications. As anaesthetists work to control his pain and monitor his condition upstairs, his wife Carol, who was riding pillion and has fractured fingers herself, waits overnight on a chair in the emergency department. Elsewhere, trauma team leader Jules treats 88-year-old Lady Carole, who has fractured her leg while walking her dog in the garden. With her family at her side, the orthopaedic team must first stabilise the severe fracture with a plaster cast before she can undergo surgery.

programme.title: Finding Britain’s Slave Traders with David Olusoga
programme.desc: David Olusoga meets the historians who have built the Register of British Slave Traders. For five years, they have searched through thousands of documents, piecing together a comprehensive picture of over 13,000 individuals who were investors in the slave trade. Anyone can now log on and discover who the slave traders were, where they lived, how much money they made and the links between modern British institutions and the trade in human beings. David discovers how the monarchy drove the early British slave trade. He learns how Elizabeth I and the early Stuarts gave their support to early slavery ventures; how the restored monarchy in the 1660s, seeking new ways to strengthen its finances and authorities, chartered a joint-stock monopoly company dedicated to the trade in enslaved Africans; and how James II, the company's governor, becoming king led to the emergence of a new and rival set of companies and investors who would transform the slave trade.

programme.title: Cheers: Gute Freundinnen
programme.desc: Die beiden Kellnerinnen im Cheers, Carla und Diane, sind in Hassliebe verbunden. Sam rät ihnen zu einem klärenden Gespräch. Die beiden Frauen bleiben nach Dienstschluß noch im Cheers, um zu reden. Carlas selbstgemixter Cocktail wirkt dabei Wunder.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Coach greift an
programme.desc: Der Coach hat eine bezaubernde Untermieterin. Nach dem Willen von Carla und Diane soll er die junge Frau sofort anflirten. Zunächst hat er wenig Erfolg bei ihr. Schließlich fällt ihm noch ein alter Aufreißertrick ein.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Glücksbringer
programme.desc: Sam trägt als Glücksbringer einen alten Kronkorken mit sich herum. Widerstrebend leiht er den Talisman einem Baseballspieler. Anschließend gerät Sam selbst in eine tiefe Krise.

programme.title: Cheers: Dianes Zitatenschatz
programme.desc: Diane sammelt Bonmots von allen möglichen Leuten im Cheers. Alle werden in ihrem Zitatenschatz verewigt. Nur der arme Sam ist wieder mal nicht schlau genug, den passenden Spruch parat zu haben.

programme.title: Cheers: Dichter oder Spion?
programme.desc: Ein ungewöhnlicher Gast im Cheers will zuerst Spion, dann Dichter von Beruf sein. Niemand glaubt ihm. Schließlich erzählt er allen, er sei Multimillionär. Auch damit findet er kein Gehör.

programme.title: Cheers: Keine Liebe, keine Werbung
programme.desc: Eine attraktive Werbefrau in mittleren Jahren verspricht Sam lukrative Fernsehspots. Das Angebot gilt nur, wenn er sich auch sonst ihr gegenüber nicht abweisend zeigt. Sam geht auf ihre Forderungen ein.

programme.title: Cheers: Geteilter Kummer
programme.desc: Diane bekommt einen Anruf von ihren Eltern. Sie muss voller Schmerz erfahren, dass ihre Katze gestorben ist. Sie erzählt allen von dem Unglück. Aber weder die Stammgäste noch ihre Kollegen wollen den Kummer mit ihr teilen.

programme.title: Cheers: Männer sind doch alle Schrott...
programme.desc: Carla ist schwanger. Die Überraschung im Cheers ist groß. Carlas Kollegen sind völlig aus dem Häuschen, als sie erfahren, wer der Vater ist: ein unscheinbarer Gelehrtentyp.

programme.title: Cheers: Unsere Bar soll sauber bleiben!
programme.desc: Die Stammbesetzung im Cheers hegt Befürchtungen, die Bar könnte zu einem Schwulentreff werden. Sofort beginnt ein hässliches Gestichel gegen Gäste, die man für homosexuell hält.

programme.title: Cheers: Das ideale Rendezvous
programme.desc: Sam und Diane denken sich ein Spielchen aus: Jeder soll dem anderen den idealen Partner zum Rendezvous herbeischaffen. Diane nimmt die Abmachung ernst und besorgt eine herbe Schönheit.

programme.title: Cheers: Bostons beste Bedienung
programme.desc: Der alljährliche Kellnerinnen-Wettbewerb der Stadt findet dieses Jahr im Cheers statt. Sam hat Diane dafür angemeldet – allerdings ohne ihr Wissen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der betrogene Betrüger
programme.desc: Der allzu vertrauensselige Coach hat 8.000 Dollar an einen Berufsspieler verloren. Sam und seine Stammbesetzung im Cheers lassen sich etwas einfallen. Sie wollen den Betrüger aufs Kreuz legen.

programme.title: Cheers: Trauung am Tresen
programme.desc: Dianes Mutter kommt zu Besuch. Der Grund: Es gibt eine Klausel im Testament ihres verstorbenen Gatten. Die besagt, dass Tochter Diane umgehend verheiratet werden muss. Als Zukünftiger bietet sich Sam an.

programme.title: Cheers: Ein Halbgott als Bruder
programme.desc: Sams Bruder Derek kommt auf Besuch ins Cheers. Er ist derjenige von beiden, der immer alles besser konnte. Folgerichtig hat er auch Diane sofort um den Finger gewickelt.

programme.title: Cheers: Hau ab und bleib hier!
programme.desc: Es scheint, als hätte Sam seine Chancen bei Diane verspielt. Sie hat sich offenbar für seinen Bruder Derek entschieden. Bevor sie ganz zu ihm geht, sucht sie eine letzte Auseinandersetzung mit Sam.

programme.title: Cheers: Deine Wohnung, meine Wohnung?
programme.desc: Diane und Sam streiten sich heftig. Das erregt sie so, dass sie sich im Bett versöhnen wollen. Sie fahren zu Dianes Wohnung, wo der Streit erneut losbricht. Sam hat etwas gegen Dianes Kuscheltiere einzuwenden. Diane schmeißt ihn kurzerhand aus der Wohnung

programme.title: Cheers: Das wilde Mauerblümchen
programme.desc: Carla erwartet ein Baby. Deshalb soll ihre Schwester Annette im Cheers aushelfen. Sie ist alles andere als ein schüchternes Mauerblümchen.

programme.title: Cheers: Geschäftliche Beziehungen
programme.desc: Norm trennt sich von seiner Frau Vera. Er leidet schwer darunter. Diane trennt sich währenddessen vom Cheers. Nach zwei Wochen findet sie einen neuen Job. Leider muss sie feststellen, dass ihr neuer Chef mehr an ihr als an ihrer Arbeit interessiert ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Kneipen-Othello
programme.desc: Diane spielt im Cheers Szenen aus Shakespeares ,,Othello". Die Hauptrolle wird von einem Ex-Häftling übernommen. Für sie als Desdemona wird das Ganze lebensgefährlich.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg und Frieden
programme.desc: Diane will, dass Sam zu einem Abendessen mit ihrem Ex-Verlobten mitkommt. Bei dem Verflossenen handelt es sich um einen Literaturprofessor. Sam versucht, seine Bildungslücken durch die Lektüre von Tolstojs ,,Krieg und Frieden" wettzumachen.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine Herzenssache
programme.desc: Carla hat unter den Gästen im Cheers einen neuen Verehrer namens Hank. Sam und Diane müssen etwas nachhelfen, bevor es zum ersten Rendezvous kommt.

programme.title: Cheers: Die 24-Stunden-Versuchung
programme.desc: Ein alter Freund von Sam hat sich ein Ziel gesetzt: Innerhalb von 24 Stunden will er Sam und Diane auseinander bringen. Dazu schickt er die hübsche Deedee vor, die den Frauenhelden Sam betören soll.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Tyrann am Spielfeldrand
programme.desc: Coach will es noch einmal wissen: Er beginnt, eine Nachwuchs-Baseballmannschaft zu trainieren. Prompt entwickelt er sich zum Tyrannen am Spielfeldrand.

programme.title: Cheers: Kampf der Giganten
programme.desc: Norm hat sich von Vera getrennt. Nun trauert er seiner Frau hinterher. Als er erfährt, dass ein alter Schulfreund sein Glück bei Vera versucht, fordert er ihn zum Zweikampf heraus.

programme.title: Cheers: Was sag' ich meiner Liebsten?
programme.desc: Sam bekommt von Diane zwei Karten für einen Boxkampf geschenkt. Vor lauter Freude sagt er zu ihr ‚Ich liebe dich‘. Diane ist sehr glücklich darüber, doch dann stellt sich heraus, dass dieser Satz für Sam nur eine Floskel ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Freundinnen meiner Freundin
programme.desc: Dianes beste Freundin Heather taucht im Cheers auf. Sam ist von der attraktiven Frau mehr als beeindruckt. Diane platzt fast vor Eifersucht und tut ihr Möglichstes, damit die zwei sich nicht zu nahe kommen.

programme.title: Le projet atticus
programme.desc: Fondé en 1976, l’Institut Atticus était spécialisé dans l’étude de personnes développant des capacités paranormales. Des centaines de personnes ont été étudiées mais aucun cas présenté jusque-là ne ressemblait à celui de Judith Winstead…

programme.title: Liberté Sauvage
programme.desc: Stella, veuve, est propriétaire d'un ranch qu'elle tente de tenir à flots en faisant appel à des prisonniers qui l'aident à s'occuper de chevaux sauvages. Elle doit faire face à de menaçants bureaucrates qui veulent mettre fin au programme qu'elle anime.

programme.title: Viking : la naissance d'une nation
programme.desc: Des guerriers vikings se battent contre des envahisseurs surnaturels dans une quête épique.

programme.title: Scorpion
programme.desc: Angelo, passionné de boxe thaï, est exclu des championnats puis tue accidentellement un rival. Après six ans de prison, brisé, il renaît par amour et devient Scorpion : une machine à combattre, prête à tout encaisser pour revenir au sommet.

programme.title: Interrogation
programme.desc: Après que le FBI a reçu une alerte à la bombe, deux spécialistes du FBI sont plongés dans un jeu mortel, dans une course désespérée contre la montre pour découvrir les véritables intentions de leur adversaire, tout en luttant pour sauver leur ville.

programme.title: Time Run
programme.desc: Sergey est un champion d'athlétisme dont la carrière est détruite en un instant par un accident de voiture. Il découvre alors que si ses blessures ont diminué ses aptitudes, elles lui ont aussi donné des capacités paranormales pour voir le passé,...

programme.title: Tueur Programme
programme.desc: Gabriel semble mener une vie bien rangée, mais dans ses rêves il est un assassin sans pitié. Jusqu'au jour où les victimes de ses rêves subissent un sort similaire dans la vie réelle...

programme.title: L'Ultime Sacrifice
programme.desc: L’histoire vraie d’un homme infiltré dans les cercles de pouvoir de Washington, risquant jusqu’à son futur pour s’assurer qu’on décerne bien une médaille d’honneur à un aviateur oublié, William H. Pitsenbarger, mort au Vietnam.

programme.title: Atrapen al gringo
programme.desc: Un criminal de carrera, capturado por las autoridades mexicanas, es enviado a una prisión de alta seguridad donde aprende a sobrevivir con la ayuda de un niño

programme.title: Tell en español
programme.desc: Un ladrón de poca monta logra robar un millón de dólares y traiciona a sus cómplices. Ahora deberá escapar de policías corruptos, sus antiguos socios, su oficial de libertad condicional e incluso de su esposa, todos decididos a quedarse con el dinero.

programme.title: Tiempo de morir
programme.desc: Después de cumplir 18 años por matar a un hombre en un duelo, un hombre regresa a su ciudad natal decidido a llevar una vida normal, pero los hijos del hombre al que mató están empeñados en vengarse.

programme.title: Atrapen al gringo
programme.desc: Un criminal de carrera, capturado por las autoridades mexicanas, es enviado a una prisión de alta seguridad donde aprende a sobrevivir con la ayuda de un niño

programme.title: Tell en español
programme.desc: Un ladrón de poca monta logra robar un millón de dólares y traiciona a sus cómplices. Ahora deberá escapar de policías corruptos, sus antiguos socios, su oficial de libertad condicional e incluso de su esposa, todos decididos a quedarse con el dinero.

programme.title: Tiempo de morir
programme.desc: Después de cumplir 18 años por matar a un hombre en un duelo, un hombre regresa a su ciudad natal decidido a llevar una vida normal, pero los hijos del hombre al que mató están empeñados en vengarse.

programme.title: Las estafadoras
programme.desc: Una mujer y su hija son estafadoras profesionales que utilizan sus armas de seducción para engañar a millonarios, hasta que la joven hija se enamora poniendo en apuros el último golpe: un excéntrico magnate del tabaco.

programme.title: Cosa de hombres
programme.desc: Jason Lee interpreta a un ejecutivo en la ciudad de Seattle que se va a casar con la hija de su jefe (Selma Blair). Su vida se convierte en una pesadilla cuando no se acuerda si la engañó durante su despedida de soltero.

programme.title: Las estafadoras
programme.desc: Una mujer y su hija son estafadoras profesionales que utilizan sus armas de seducción para engañar a millonarios, hasta que la joven hija se enamora poniendo en apuros el último golpe: un excéntrico magnate del tabaco.

programme.title: Mystic pizza
programme.desc: En esta tierna historia de anhelos de juventud, Julia Roberts, Annabeth Gish y Lili Taylor, son tres chicas trabajando en una pizzería y soñando con un futuro brillante fuera de su pueblecito Mystic, Connecticut.

programme.title: Cosas que diría con solo mirarla
programme.desc: Una historia compuesta de cinco tramas entrelazadas que se centran en un grupo de mujeres cuyas vidas, en el transcurso de unos pocos días, se enredan, se erosionan, se enriquecen y, finalmente, terminan por cambiar para siempre.

programme.title: Cosa de hombres
programme.desc: Jason Lee interpreta a un ejecutivo en la ciudad de Seattle que se va a casar con la hija de su jefe (Selma Blair). Su vida se convierte en una pesadilla cuando no se acuerda si la engañó durante su despedida de soltero.

programme.title: Les femmes de ses rêves
programme.desc: Ben Stiller interprète Eddie, un célibataire endurci de 40 ans, qui finit par dire "oui" à la belle Lila. Mais durant leur lune de miel, la femme de ses rêves devient un vrai cauchemar.

programme.title: Blue Chips
programme.desc: Pete Bell, un entraîneur de basket universitaire, est sous pression. Son équipe ne gagne pas. Les vedettes du futur sont payées par d'autres équipes. C'est une pratique interdite en sport universitaire, mais Pete est désespéré.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Lorsque la quête d'une mine de diamants conduit tragiquement un explorateur au Congo, son père et le directeur de l'opération envoit Dr. Karen Ross dans la jungle pour rechercher... peut-être son fils, mais principalement les diamants.

programme.title: Black Snake Moan
programme.desc: Dans cette fable d'amour, le nominé aux Oscars Samuel L. Jackson et Christina Ricci cherchent la rédemption dans le Sud profond grâce au blues et à la transcendance d'une amitié peu probable.

programme.title: Flashbacks Of A Fool
programme.desc: Daniel Craig livre une performance étonnante dans le rôle de Joe Scot, une star hollywoodienne has-been à la dérive plongé dans un brouillard de sexe, de drogues et de gloire dilapidée.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: Une invention biochimique permet de sauver la fille de Lin Dong. Mais elle est convoitée par un mystérieux groupe criminel. Lin Dong va tout faire pour la protéger des criminels qui la traque.

programme.title: The Last Wave
programme.desc: Une catastrophe naturelle menace d’engloutir les États-Unis. Un groupe de scientifiques tente d’arrêter l’inévitable avant qu’il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Secousse Sismique
programme.desc: Charley Baxter découvre qu'un tremblement de terre géant va annihiler le nord de l'Atlantique. Il doit désormais travailler avec le Dr Amy Lane, sismologue, afin d'arrêter le gouffre qui menace de couper l'Amérique et le reste du monde en deux.

programme.title: Hours
programme.desc: Alors que l’ouragan Katrina frappe la Nouvelle-Orléans, un jeune père doit lutter pour la survie de son bébé prématuré dans un hôpital déserté de tous… ou presque.

programme.title: 2012: Supernova
programme.desc: Quand une étoile dans une galaxie voisine devient instable, une supernova, un astrophysicien réalise un plan dangereux et désespéré pour protéger la Terre des radiations qui la menacent.

programme.title: Ape Vs Mecha ape
programme.desc: Reconnaissant la puissance de son gigantesque singe captif, l'armée crée son propre A.I. prêt au combat, Mecha Ape. Mais son premier test tourne horriblement mal.

programme.title: Les racines de l’Apocalypse
programme.desc: Une société biotechnologique découvre que des graines du jardin d'Eden peuvent améliorer l'environnement. Mais, entre de mauvaises mains, elles déclenchent la croissance de racines anciennes, menaçant la planète de tsunamis et de tremblements de terre.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: Un professeur d'astronomie; ancien de la NASA; découvre qu'un énorme astéroïde est sur le point d'entrer en collision avec la Terre. Il doit mettre sa famille à l'abri tout en alertant le monde de cette catastrophe imminente.

programme.title: The Bad Guys
programme.desc: Un convoi transportant de très dangereux prisonniers est intercepté par des complices afin de les libérer. La police décide de constituer une unité spéciale formée de criminels. Leur mission : les retrouver et les arrêter.

programme.title: Chroniques du royaume des esprits
programme.desc: En 1979, un jeune soldat travaille dans les montagnes enneigées de la Chine quand une explosion révèle des fossiles étranges cachés au plus profond des cavernes de la montagne. Ce qu'il découvre va changer sa vie et l'histoire humaine à jamais...

programme.title: Le Sorcier et le Serpent blanc
programme.desc: Un herboriste tombe amoureux d'un serpent vieux de cent ans déguisé sous les traits d'une femme. C'est alors qu'un sorcier découvre la supercherie et se bat pour sauver l'âme du vieil homme.

programme.title: La sorcière blanche
programme.desc: Au crépuscule de la dynastie des Ming, les Mandchous sont prêts à attaquer l’empire affaibli. La sorcière Jade Rashka sauve alors les victimes en combattant les soldats.

programme.title: Le Royaume Interdit
programme.desc: Une découverte faite par un adolescent américain obsédé par le kung-fu l'envoie à l'aventure en Chine, où il rejoint un groupe de guerriers d'arts martiaux afin de libérer le roi des singes emprisonné.

programme.title: Mystery
programme.desc: Yongzhao mène une double vie. Marié à Lu Jie, il est aussi un mari infidèle. Quand sa femme l'aperçoit entrer dans un hôtel avec une inconnue, les masques tombent...

programme.title: Best of the Best 3
programme.desc: Un instructeur d'arts martiaux prend la défense d'une institutrice qui a pris position contre une organisation suprématiste blanche locale.
